content.title: 2026 March Madness TV schedule for Elite 8: Tip times, announcers, where to watch NCAA Tournament games
content.text: Getty Images The Elite Eight of the 2026 NCAA Tournament begins Saturday with four games across two days set to determine the Final Four. Are you ready?! March Madness is heating up across CBS and TBS, which will carry you through the conclusion of the Big Dance.Paramount+ subscribers will be able to watch every game airing on CBS, while the March Madness Live app will have every game, period. There's also HBO Max, which carries all the games going up on TBS.CBS has carried a significant load of tournament inventory, broadcasting 21 games up to the Elite 8. As this is an even year, TBS similarly had 21 games, but it will also serve as home of the Final Four.Below are the announcing teams, channel assignments and tip times for every Elite 8 game on Saturday and Sunday.
